name: Equipment inventory (Strobe Light)
description: Press [$[action_equipment_use]] to toggle the strobe light on or off. Press [$[action_equipment_secondary]] to toggle MOB (man overboard) mode, which will automatically turn the strobe light on if the player is submerged in water. The strobe light will continue to function when unequipped or discarded. Requires electric charge to function, and will recharge when placed into a powered small equipment storage unit.
shortDescription: A small equipment storage unit containing a strobe light.
